findings.title: Record the verified 一 source passage and remaining access gaps
findings.details: The 字源 entry for 一 was checked against supplied scan pixels, including its numeral account, classification as 指事, historical notes, and cited bibliography. The scan’s printed page number could not be identified, and the glyph identities in its discussion of doubled forms remain visually unresolved. The underlying pages cited by 字源 were not separately inspected; the research record attributes those claims to 字源. These are source-access limits, not established errors in the article.
findings.verification: Retain the scan-checked passage and precise limits in the character research record. If the doubled-form spellings become material, resolve their identities against the scan before normalizing or quoting them; do not claim independent verification of 字源’s cited references.

findings.title: Resolve conflicting review guidance on 一 formation type
findings.details: Round 0 readability review requested `disputed` because the concrete graphic route was unresolved. Round 1 factual and readability reviews instead requested `indicative`, distinguishing the supported numeral-mark analysis from uncertainty about whether the line arose directly or through fingers or counting rods. The round 2 factual and readability reviews passed with `indicative` and qualified wording. The rejected `disputed` proposal is not an established article error; preserve the distinction between formation classification and uncertainty about the mark’s concrete origin.
findings.verification: When reviewing analogous cases, check whether uncertainty concerns the formation category or only a proposed graphic route. Confirm the accepted `indicative` classification and qualification against the cited evidence and exact approved article hash.
